name: viktor-going-in-anyway
note: The criterion that costs him something. V announces a job Viktor just advised against; the sheet says he stops arguing and says where to hit, because V is going anyway. Post-heist, so the Relic variant of the relationship is the one that must render -- and no quest is tracked, so the durable intent stands. Watch for two failures: a refusal to help dressed up as concern, and a lecture that repeats the warning he already gave.

player.appearance: V is of Hispanic descent, has black hair and has an athletic build.

messages.text: Haven't seen you in three weeks. How's the head? Any bleeds, blackouts?
Busy. Right. Come by tomorrow, six, I'll run a full scan. Won't take an hour.
Can't. Got a thing tonight. Maelstrom crew in Northside sitting on a shipment.
Northside. Alone. Kid, that's not a job, that's a coin flip.

ask: I hear you. I'm still going.
